content.text:
I answered from the diagnostic hierarchy in the question and did not test it against the data. I opened the CSV only to check its layout. In that hierarchy, pathophysiological and pattern diagnoses such as radiculopathy cause symptoms, and lumbago (low back pain) is a symptom. So R S1 radiculopathy is the more likely cause of lumbago, not the other way round.

ANSWER: B
